title: Immersive Stream
body:
# Immersive Stream

*Epic Twitch Integration?*

## What is Immersive Stream?

Immersive stream is a tool to allow viewers to join your server and spectate! This is the only feature available right now.

In future, it will offer configurable support for: 

- Subscriber benefits
  - Name colours depending on sub status
  - Paid/sub only access to the server

- Ways to troll the streamer 
  - Effects when a user donates (like blindness, nausea, strength, haste)
  - Sound effects like jumpscares (likely depending on sound physics remastered mod)

And more!
  

- Ability to read chat through mineraft (Possibly two way?)

# How to use Immersive Stream?

**TBD** But this will include setting up a twitch application, and configuring the mod
